title: Operator norm of a linear functional on R^n via its gradient coordinates
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (L : Euclid n →L[ℝ] ℝ), ‖L‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin n, L (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ a : Fin n → ℝ, |∑ i : Fin n, L (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * a i| ≤ ‖L‖ * Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, a i ^ 2)
